edits.prompt: Use case: text-localization. Make exactly one tiny text correction to this Chinese CCLink Studio product storyboard. In the top-right screenshot, the 3D toolbar currently has 旋转, 测量, 版面. Change ONLY the word 测量 to 线框, because this design must not imply a measurement capability. Preserve the entire image composition, all frames, arrows, dimensions, content, typography, icons, text, colors and layout pixel-for-pixel as closely as possible. No other changes. This remains a design mockup.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Correct exactly two issues in this Chinese CCLink Studio product storyboard. 1) ONLY in the UPPER LEFT screenshot, replace its left sidebar headed 项目类型 with the same diary sidebar used in the upper right screenshot: 今天, 日记, 计划, 定时整理, 文件, 会话, 工具, bottom 设置. Remove ALL project type choices 研发项目/资料整理/通用项目. This is a Git acquisition dialog, NOT a type selector. Keep the dialog and all its existing fields and captions unchanged. 2) In the LOWER RIGHT small 启用前检查 inset, replace the green check circle to the left of 请检查另一台电脑，避免重复执行 with an AMBER warning/info icon, since that is an unverified reminder. Keep the preceding green check for 执行时间、输出位置已核对. Preserve all other text, frames, arrows, dimensions, layout, status, colors, and imagery exactly. Do not add new features or panels.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished high-resolution Chinese desktop product-design storyboard for CCLink Studio v0.2. Landscape canvas approximately 2400x1800, crisp readable simplified Chinese typography. Graphite black VSCode-inspired interface, restrained blue accent, warm white text, thin borders, dense but calm real desktop app proportions, no glossy marketing graphics. All screenshots are fictional product mockups, clearly marked “设计效果图 · 示例内容” in footer. Layout: title and concise flow arrow line at top, two small numbered UI screenshots side by side in upper half, one wide larger numbered final-state UI screenshot in lower half. Numbered captions OUTSIDE app windows, not extra navigation inside the app. Use clear arrows linking 1 → 2 → 3. Top app bar shows actual projects “我的空间”, “我的公司”, “眼镜研发”, and “＋”. No global mode selector, no extra business-mode navigation row, no new hierarchy named super-project. Project type controls LEFT sidebar; content tabs control work layout. Settings entry at bottom of sidebar; account and role management NEVER occupy business sidebar. Use ONLY short intentional text supplied; avoid dense filler, random Latin, imaginary analytics. Screens use consistent shell.
Title “首次使用：接回原来的日记与计划”. Flow line “选择原资料 → 核对日记、计划和任务 → 继续今天”.
Frame 1 caption “1 进入我的空间”. Active top project 我的空间. Sidebar 今天 / 日记 / 计划 / 定时整理, separator 文件 / 会话 / 工具, bottom 设置. Main title “接回你的日记与计划”, two clear buttons “关联已有资料” primary, “开始新的日记” secondary. Small text “资料保留在原位置”. Don't show fake recent notes before association.
Frame 2 caption “2 核对原资料与两个任务”. In same shell a compact connection panel shows root “woniu-forward / 000-个人计划”, three rows “日记  2026 / 11”, “计划  周计划、一日生活计划”, “定时整理  每日简报、每周计划和总结”. Small secondary line “沿用原任务和本机状态”. Action “关联并打开”. Footer “不移动文件，不新建重复任务”. Do not show a success tick before confirmation.
Frame 3 wide caption “3 首页直接读到原文”. Active 我的空间. Header “今天 · 11月19日”, small “日记项目 · 资料已关联”. Center main left large document preview titled “今日记录”, body short actual sample “昨日总结 / 眼镜项目：确认供电方案。 / 今日待做 / 检查结构尺寸，整理本周进展。 / 今日打卡 / 09:00 开始工作。” Primary “继续写今天”; a small secondary explanatory callout outside preview “今日文件不存在时：准备今日日记；已有文件直接打开”. Main right narrow two cards “本周计划” with “眼镜研发 / 资料整理”; “定时整理” rows “每日简报 · 本机已启用” and “每周计划和总结 · 本机已启用”, link “查看任务”. Bottom status “原资料位置 · woniu-forward”. No Agent panel needed on home; optional compact assistant icon only. User sees useful content, not huge welcome marketing empty space.

Title “日常使用：项目组织工作，版面跟随内容”. Flow line “从公司进入工程 → 文档、网页、模型切换 → 返回公司继续处理”.
Frame 1 caption “1 从公司打开关联工程”. Active 我的公司. Sidebar 公司概览 / 业务项目 / 公司账目 / 运营内容, then 文件 / 会话 / 工具, bottom 设置. Main “业务项目”, one business record “智能眼镜”, secondary “关联工程：眼镜研发”, action “打开工程”. Small task row “文章发布 · 等待确认”. Do not automatically create a second engineering folder.
Frame 2 caption “2 在同一工程内切换内容”. Active 眼镜研发. Sidebar 工程概览 / 设计文件 / 生产资料 / 检查报告 / 文件 / 会话 / 工具 / 设置. Content tabs “说明.md”, “器件资料”, “外壳.step”; active 外壳.step with realistic restrained gray eyeglasses chassis CAD wireframe/solid viewport on dark canvas. Small viewport toolbar “旋转  测量  版面”. Right Agent panel narrow, header “Agent · 眼镜研发”, short line “当前文件：外壳.step”. A small external caption beneath screenshot “文档用 Markdown，网页用浏览器，模型用 3D；工程不变”. No full EDA editing promises.
Frame 3 wide caption “3 返回公司，原任务仍可找到”. Active 我的公司. Company sidebar identical frame1. Main company overview title “公司概览”. Left area “业务项目” with “智能眼镜” and associated “眼镜研发 →”; another small “最近资料” with “本周进展.md”. Right Agent panel header “Agent · 我的公司”, input placeholder “输入消息”. Bottom expanded compact run drawer labeled “进行中的工作”, two real-status example rows “我的公司 · 文章发布 · 等待确认  [查看]” and “眼镜研发 · 资料整理 · 运行中  [返回工程]”. Small clear caption outside app “切换项目不改任务归属；关闭标签不取消任务”. A menu inset at upper-right of this wide frame (not covering main content) titled project-name dropdown contains only “项目设置”, “关闭项目”, “从历史移除”. No delete-files button here. No second workmode row. Grey accounts and roles absent sidebar.

Title “换电脑：先恢复项目，再补齐本机连接”. Flow line “从 Git 获取 → 检查本机缺项 → 继续原来的工作”.
Frame 1 caption “1 从 Git 获取到新目录”. Simple dialog inside same desktop app shell, title “从 Git 获取”, fields “仓库地址” displaying “团队日记仓库” and “保存位置” displaying “~/Projects/我的日记”, action “获取并打开”. Small note “下载后读取项目类型”. No type picker before clone. Tiny label “此例：仓库已包含项目设置与共享任务定义”.
Frame 2 caption “2 首页列出需要补齐的项目”. Active 我的空间. Diary sidebar 今天 / 日记 / 计划 / 定时整理 / 文件 / 会话 / 工具 / 设置. Main “项目已打开 · 日记”, short card “本机需要连接” with exactly three rows: “外部资料未连接  [重新关联]”, “本地 Agent 未安装  [安装]”, “两个整理任务未在本机启用  [检查任务]”. Below neutral text “项目内的日记和计划可直接打开”. Warning not panic: “另一台电脑的启用状态不会自动复制”. No blanket blocking fullscreen wizard.
Frame 3 wide caption “3 确认后恢复日常首页”. Active 我的空间. Main left today diary preview title “今天”, sample “昨日总结 / 继续整理项目进展。 / 今日待做 / 完成本周计划。” button “继续写今天”. Main right status card “项目与本机” with three readable rows “项目设置 · 已纳入 Git”, “资料 · 项目内＋本机已关联”, “自动整理 · 本机已启用”. Under it small task card “每日简报 / 每周计划和总结”, link “查看任务”. A compact confirmation inset OUTSIDE the app or as bottom-right small preceding-state card titled “启用前检查” with lines “执行时间、输出位置已核对”, “请检查另一台电脑，避免重复执行”, button “在本机启用”. Label it “上一步确认” so no contradiction with final enabled state. Bottom outside-app footnote “无共享任务定义时：明确提示从原电脑导出后接回。Git 更新先预览新副本，再确认切换关联。” No fake cloud sync or guaranteed distributed scheduler. No automatic task execution as clone consequence.
